rule: Disposable worktrees under .cache/worktrees are generated views. Horca src/, overlay/, config/, and scripts/ are source of truth.
action: Harvested direct worktree edits into Horca-owned inputs, then destroy and rematerialize.
horcaOwnedAdds: gate-d1-r-add-* entries copy from src/ (Ghostty modules, pane-terminal, orca-pane-*, orca-terminal-surface).
orcaOriginReplaces: gate-d1-r replace entries copy from overlay/d1-r/ into pinned Orca files.
droppedDuplicateReplaces: Horca-owned files must not also have overlay/d1-r replace entries. Add-from-src is the origin.
harvestedOrcaOriginAfterDirectEdit: overlay/d1-r updated from the disposable tree for D1-R Ghostty cutover files
new replace overlays for D0 files further edited (requireXtermPaneState removal, proposeDimensions null coalescing)
